about: Hand decisions about MX3 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every value was read off the page image by the survey (apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/mx3.md, Stat blocks, the misprints table; decisions 4 and 5); none is a guess from OCR, and each printed value here is what the parse reads.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: the printed page in the Adventure Book and the start of the entry's header
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read

No reading of the four failing chapter grids (Gilda Ginsel, Bill Gregson, Marco Pene, the Maintenance Robots) adds up on the printed numbers, the codes' standard numbers or their lowest, so each failing total is corrected to the sum of the printed numbers and the numbers are kept (survey decision 4). Their twelve numbers inside a range but off its standard pass on the registry's rank_ranges (decision 5).

overrides.note: Printed P M(30) (printed 6): M is no rank code and 30 is Remarkable's standard number, so the code is RM; read as a row with its code unread by the registry's unread_codes. Health 50 is printed for F+A+S+E = 4+6+5+7 = 22, and Karma 35 for R+I+P = 10+15+30 = 55. Survey decision 4.
Health 40 is printed for F+A+S+E = 7+5+8+7 = 27, and Karma 20 for R+I+P = 10+10+5 = 25 (printed 9). Survey decision 4.
Health 55 is printed for F+A+S+E = 16+20+10+15 = 61, and Karma 10 for R+I+P = 10+16+20 = 46 (printed 16). Survey decision 4.

Health 35 is printed for F+A+S+E = 15+20+20+75 = 130; 35 is their F and A alone (printed 27). Karma = 0 is printed on purpose, robots, as MX1's and MX2's sentinels, with R PR(4) and I and P Shift 0(0). Survey decision 4.
